front.title: An Agentic AI Framework for the Management of Networks, Security, and AI Services

author.organization: Intelligent Information R and D Division Mobility Platform Research Center

abstract.t: This document specifies an agentic AI framework for the management of networks, security, and AI services. This framework is an Intent- Based System (IBS) to enforce a human-language intent at a target network with the translated policy for networks, security, or AI services. It consists of a User System, a Cloud System, an Edge System, and a Device. Target devices in this framework include Network Forwarding Elements (e.g., router and switch), Network Security Functions (e.g., firewall, web filter, and DDoS-attack mitigator), Internet-of-Things (IoT) Devices, Physicak AI Robots, Software-Defined Vehicles (SDV), Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), and Urban Air Mobility (UAM). This document describes the agentic AI framework with its components and interfaces where the components include AI agents and supporting knowledge repositories (i.e., knowledge base), and also inter-agent interfaces use the Agent-to- Agent (A2A) protocol.
